notes.title: DreamBack VR | Available Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JYi2_vGjRCw;full][/previewyoutube]

Today it's a very special day. After almost three years of development we're releasing DreamBack VR which we consider a small piece of our heart.

Sometimes you have to face your terrors to overcome them. But some memories are best left unearthed... 

[b]Dreamback VR[/b] is now available on Steam for $24.99 USD with a 10% launch discount! 

Experience true horror in your own skin in virtual reality

[u]A thousand thanks to all who supported us during this long and hard journey.[/u]

notes.title: DreamBack VR | Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[b]DreamBack VR[/b] by [b]Come Over Gaming[/b] will be released on June 10th for $24.99 on Steam VR, with a launch discount of a 10% off. 

[previewyoutube=YCveG4ApBrY;full][/previewyoutube]

Try to unravel the mysteries of the eerie Rickfford Mansion without losing your sanity in pure terror. 
A first-person psychological horror game in VR by Come Over Gaming.

[b]Wishlist and follow:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923230/DreamBack_VR/
